sources.observation: Critical occurrence is determined at attack beginning rather than projectile launch or impact. Post7.30 strongest-first short-circuit and lower-priority PRD preservation are separate rules.
Time Lock additional attacks can trigger attack/on-hit effects including Time Lock; they ignore disarm without true strike and ranged attackers release ordinary attack projectiles.
Moment of Courage attacks can apply ordinary attack/on-hit effects without true strike. A nonattacking owner uses a temporary1000attack-speed preparation path rather than always attacking instantly.
Additional projectiles launch with the main attack projectile regardless of its eventual hit,using the ordinary projectile speed and excluding attack modifiers/on-hit effects.

Specific Chaos Strike text places determination during its attack point and mentions a distinct attack animation. That phrase may refer to the windup interval and does not independently establish a single exact frame; compare with the generic Critical Strike beginning-of-attack rule.

engineRequirements.rule: C4 migrates the eleven previously configured native templates plus Death Ward and Frost Spire to creation-time attack/motion identity,flat BaseAS,unfolded BAT and independent animation scaling. Scoped thirteen-template result evidence is in native-unit-profiles.json. This parent requirement stays open for other summon/illusion templates and their remaining inheritance/classification audits; a finite attack-profile result set does not certify every summon.

C5 source audit establishes three actual caller gaps: Time Lock and Moment of Courage incorrectly suppress ordinary attack/on-hit effects; ranged Time Lock lacks its ordinary projectile path; nonattacking Courage lacks its preparation path. Specialist Array currently starts from landed attacks rather than simultaneous launch and its false flag still leaks generic critical/lifesteal providers. Implement explicit per-caller rules and real results instead of certifying triggerModifiers:false as a universal native rule. Historical7.31d/February2023 Time Lock delays its second attack and bonus damage by0.4seconds,while the current caller deals bonus damage immediately and schedules a0.1second follow-up; ranged follow-ups additionally need projectile travel.

Current shared selection orders a variable critical by its maximum profile, while fixed-count Luminosity probes at point and also advances at impact. The exact variable-versus-fixed native priority and simultaneous in-flight fixed-count behavior still require per-skill evidence and result tests. Existing passing Chaos/PA launch snapshots do not certify these unreviewed matrices.

Classify remaining direct init effects,spawned aura dependencies and simultaneous startup triggers before certifying a universal native priority. C4 only proves constant initial passives precede deferred immediate area ticks; it does not turn every init hook into a proven native battle-start phase.

Current occurrence snapshots happen at attack-point dispatch. The2022genericcritical page explicitly says beginning rather than projectile launch/impact,while2023Chaos Strike uses the ambiguous phrase during attack point. Resolve the exact per-caller deadline and animation implications before forcing a universal change. Add real windup-time Break,provider-removal,chance-change and launch/impact cases; independent in-flight snapshots alone do not certify the native windup rule.
